topics.rebuilt: prep topic emg-silent-speech-knowledge-distillation matched only the target (n=1); rebuilt across all signal types
topics.inclusion_rule: Speech, word or language decoding studies from any non-acoustic or audio-visual signal (EMG, EEG, ECoG, intracortical, lip video, ultrasound, wearable strain or inertial sensors) that train a student model on teacher outputs or representations (knowledge distillation, teacher-student, self-distillation), found by ledger text or full text; design compared: where the teacher comes from (audio/ASR or cross-modal teacher, an ensemble of teachers, a larger same-modality model) and whether distillation is used for model compression. Boundary: full-text counts are pattern matches and include mentions in related work; acoustic-only ASR distillation is out of scope when read; versions count once.
topics.metric: 26-class accuracy of the distilled student against its teacher; higher is better.

topics.inclusion_rule: Studies that decode words or utterances from non-acoustic signals (neural, EMG, articulatory, video) by classifying each detected segment into a closed set of at most a few hundred words or utterances, with or without a language-model or context prior over the sequence. Boundary: open-vocabulary phoneme or character decoders are excluded unless they also report a closed-set word test; acoustic-only ASR is excluded.

Include silent-speech recognition studies using facial surface EMG that specify or compare electrode, channel, or muscle placement and relate the configuration to word-recognition performance. Boundary: exclude EMG studies without placement or muscle details and studies that change only the decoder or signal-processing method.
topics.metric: 26-class word-recognition accuracy (%) across facial-EMG channel or muscle configurations; higher is better.

topics.inclusion_rule: Word or command classification studies whose ledger names a wearable non-acoustic sensor on the face or neck (strain, piezo or triboelectric sensor, surface EMG, accelerometer); the design compared is how test samples are separated from training samples: speaker-disjoint, session- or day-disjoint, or a random or per-class sample split. Boundary: a paper counts under every split it reports; reviews and acoustic-only studies are excluded when read.

topics.rebuilt: prep topic silent-speech-model-latency-footprint had no usual approach (audit_tally FAIL); replaced by the published on-device inference table
topics.inclusion_rule: Non-acoustic silent-speech or speech-recognition wearables (EMG, strain, accelerometer, ultrasound, EEG) whose decoder runs on an embedded processor or microcontroller on or near the body, rather than on a PC, phone or cloud; design compared: whether inference latency, energy per inference and total system power are measured. Boundary: neural implants with external rack processing, acoustic-only keyword spotting and PC-tethered real-time demos are excluded when read; versions once.
topics.metric: inference latency, model size and system power measured on the wearable's own processor; lower is better.
